themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints spiked to 90 THIS WEEK versus a 22.2 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 304% increase (z-score: 10.46)—suggesting a widespread pavement or pothole problem emerged suddenly in Forest Hills/Rego Park.
evidence: 90 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 22.2 weekly average (304% spike, z-score: 10.46)
Dangling street signs also up 500% this week (9 complaints vs. 1.5 avg, z-score: 5.0), suggesting systemic street infrastructure deterioration
Curb condition complaints up 586% last week (6 vs. 0.9 avg), reinforcing pattern of sudden street-level decay
reporting_angles: Walk the most complaint-heavy blocks with DOT inspector to document damage and timeline
Interview residents about whether recent weather, construction, or deferred maintenance triggered the crisis

themes_detail.label: Dangerous Traffic Signals Spike
themes_detail.summary: Traffic signal condition complaints reached 80 TWO WEEKS AGO versus 21.5 weekly average—a 272% increase (z-score: 5.98)—indicating a cluster of malfunctioning signals that may pose intersection safety risks.
evidence: 80 traffic signal complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 21.5 weekly average (272% spike, z-score: 5.98)
Traffic signals are safety-critical; malfunction creates collision and pedestrian injury risk
No recent local news coverage suggests issue may be underreported to media despite high 311 volume
reporting_angles: Obtain DOT work orders from past 2 weeks to identify which intersections were reported and whether repairs were completed
Interview NYPD traffic or local precinct about any accident uptick at problem intersections

themes_detail.label: School Maintenance Emergency
themes_detail.summary: School maintenance complaints exploded to 8 THREE WEEKS AGO versus 0.5 weekly baseline—a 1500% spike (z-score: 10.61, highest severity)—suggesting acute facility problems in Forest Hills/Rego Park schools.
evidence: 8 school maintenance complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (1500% spike, z-score: 10.61—highest recorded spike)
Community Board budget requests include senior center and youth facility upgrades, suggesting district infrastructure strain
276 DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (223 alterations) indicates heavy construction activity; school maintenance spike may reflect delayed repairs or facility degradation
reporting_angles: Contact DOE to identify which schools in CD 406 filed maintenance complaints and what conditions triggered them
Interview parents, teachers, or union reps about classroom conditions (HVAC, bathrooms, heating, safety hazards)

themes_detail.label: Dead and Dying Trees Spike
themes_detail.summary: Dead/dying tree complaints reached 5 LAST WEEK versus 0.5 weekly average—a 900% increase (z-score: 6.36)—indicating potential environmental health and street-tree canopy loss in the district.
evidence: 5 dead/dying tree complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly average (900% spike, z-score: 6.36)
Community Board budget requests include 'provide a new or expanded park or amenity'—tree loss may worsen green space deficits
Converges with street infrastructure spike, suggesting district-wide maintenance backlog
reporting_angles: Map the 5 tree complaint locations to identify if loss is clustered in one neighborhood
Interview Parks Department about tree maintenance schedule and whether budget constraints are delaying care

themes_detail.label: Park Noise Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Park-related noise complaints jumped to 5 THIS WEEK versus 0.9 weekly average—a 471% spike (z-score: 5.28)—suggesting either new noise-generating activity or resident frustration with park conditions.
evidence: 5 park noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average (471% spike, z-score: 5.28)
Community Board budget requests prioritize new/expanded parks, suggesting existing parks may be under-resourced or congested
No Reddit or local news coverage indicates issue emerging without media awareness
reporting_angles: Identify which parks generated complaints and whether new activities (construction, events, or groups) started recently
Survey park users about noise sources and enforcement
